No installed service, source protocol or deployment pin change.

nodes.label: Mac 原生笔记生命周期与未知外部效果局部验证

notes_owner.scope: Owner in-process native protocol with real isolated PostgreSQL; NOLOGIN SET ROLE pools, synthetic NativeReceipt and per-task memory archive; post-commit callback return loss, not network or official DSH process

native_process.scope: Independent Runtime/Worker/Storage with fixed official native-v4 Node, two fresh databases and three LOGIN roles; Registry/ToolHub/model/MCP protocol fixtures, fsynced synthetic external effect and actual TCP reply loss, controlled explicit operator reconciliation

nodes.label: Mac Console 原生引擎面板与工作状态恢复边界
nodes.scope: Console exact fixed-engine evidence UI corrected and matching local BFF/Web package installed; Runtime native source-state recovery covered separately with Owner PostgreSQL/HTTP fixtures. No browser, official Node recovery, general failed-run continuation, real provider or Windows acceptance.

console_ui.scope: SSR initial rendering and direct archive-download callback; actual Console uses the components. No browser, DOM/fetch recovery-response interaction or automatic continuation claim.

runtime_owner.scope: In-process Owner with real PostgreSQL and SourceState HTTP policy, NOLOGIN SET ROLE application pools, synthetic model receipt, memory archive and callback-level reply loss; no SQL-fabricated run state, actual TCP loss, Worker retry loop, official Node or Storage process. Archive lost-ack naturally failed/not_waiting; archive_unconfirmed diagnostic and external-tool unknown not added.

nodes.label: Mac Runtime 失败任务只读接续预览
nodes.scope: Control-only read-only failed continuation preview v1 implemented and locally installed in Runtime; Owner PostgreSQL/HTTP fixtures plus read-only observations of existing Mac failures. No new execution action, generic resume guard, UI integration, provider retry or business/Windows acceptance.

api.positive_assessment: same_run_candidate is an observation, never execution authorization

runtime_owner.scope: Owner in-process real isolated PostgreSQL and servicehttp authorization, NOLOGIN SET ROLE pools, synthetic native receipt and memory archive. Positive paths use normal APIs; five corrupt-record negative fixtures are deliberate injections. Separate actor invokes old resume in consistency test; GET never performs that action. No official Node/independent Worker/Storage or provider.

installed_observation.scope: Twelve named execution/notes table row digests and full terminal task metadata agree at observation endpoints across installation and GETs. HTTP and SQL snapshots are separate; no admission lock or continuous immutability proof. Excludes instances, app_runs, business_runs and all other tables; no live provider retry, Storage-byte validation, UI, business or Windows acceptance.

nodes.label: Mac native 模型新尝试规则修订守卫
nodes.scope: Native BeginModel admission guard rejects a new stale-revision attempt while preserving completed receipts and frozen history. Owner and actual old/new Worker plus fixed official Node/synthetic TLS fixtures verified; both own-Mac Workers updated. Runtime HTTP remains 879c5034; continuation action/UI, real provider/business and Windows acceptance remain open.

runtime_owner.scope: Owner real isolated PG and execution APIs with synthetic callbacks/memory archives, no actual Worker/Node/provider execution

worker_fixture.model_http_scope: Synthetic loopback TLS only; actual independent Worker binaries and fixed official Node runner, real Runtime HTTP and PG, archive fixture.
worker_fixture.request_equality: Complete canonical JSON values agree with original frozen intent and every call/attempt; raw wire hashes are preserved and differ for replay requests.

worker_installation.scope: Scalar observations and process checks are separate, not an atomic admission lock or full-row comparison; normal instance heartbeats remain possible. A later root live observation confirmed both new workers and eight unchanged peers.

nodes.label: Mac 显式接续动作与Console回执恢复源码
nodes.scope: Explicit manual continuation action, durable Owner receipt and Console recovery-pointer source implemented and locally committed. Isolated Owner and independent Worker/official Node/synthetic TLS plus Console source checks passed with explicit skips/limits. No live schema migration, service deployment, mounted/browser flow, real provider/business or Windows acceptance.

contract.receipt_retention: Permanent Owner decision history, no TTL; Runtime SELECT/INSERT, no new Worker grant

broad_regression.scope: Top-level passes can include grouping tests whose opt-in leaves skip; 27 explicit skip events are retained. The independent revision Worker run is covered separately, not relabelled in this invocation.

runtime_tests.permissions: Isolated real PG with NOLOGIN/SET ROLE; not credential-authenticated login acceptance
runtime_tests.reply_loss: External HTTP connection dropped after Handler committed; PostgreSQL COMMIT response loss not injected

worker_tests.source_actor: Explicit action at R1, then optional Constraints R2 before second Worker Claim
worker_tests.scope: Actual separate old/new Worker binaries and pinned official Node adaptation; real isolated Runtime HTTP/PG, synthetic loopback TLS model and archive fixture. Complete canonical bodies bind frozen exchanges/calls/attempts; raw wire hashes may differ.

console_tests.scope: MemoryStorage/fake fetch, static render and upstream proxy fixtures; no mounted React hook/click/unmount, real cross-tab StorageEvents or browser acceptance.
